name: telegram-sharing
title: Telegram Sharing
description: Shares browser page or copied text to Telegram
author: gianpiero_spinelli

commands.name: share-url
commands.title: Share URL to Telegram
commands.subtitle: Share the current browser page via Telegram
commands.description: Share the current browser page via Telegram

commands.name: share-clipboard
commands.title: Share Clipboard to Telegram
commands.subtitle: Share clipboard content via Telegram
commands.description: Share whatever is in your clipboard via Telegram

tools.name: share-telegram
tools.title: Share to Telegram
tools.description: Share text content to Telegram. Use this tool when the user wants to send or share text, messages, or AI-generated content to Telegram.

ai.instructions: Use this extension to share content to Telegram. When the user asks to share something to Telegram or mentions @telegram, use the share-telegram tool with the content to share.

preferences.name: useBrowserExtension
preferences.label: Use Browser Extension
preferences.description: Use the Raycast Browser Extension to get the current page URL. When disabled, falls back to AppleScript.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
